_about: League websites that show TimeToScore games (for the lead's timetoscore adapter and the replay's game identity). Each site embeds the TimeToScore game widget (cdn.timetoscore.com/game/loader.js or api.<host>.timetoscore.com) and its game id IS the TimeToScore game_id on stats.<host>.timetoscore.com (checked: AHF 86577, THF 85997, NGHL 85833, AGHF 84225 on blackbear; USPHL 27005 on usphl). So analyst links like usphl.com/ncdc/game-center/?game_id=27005 equal stats.usphl.timetoscore.com game 27005. site_url: the league site's game page for a TimeToScore game id.
